description: Defines the HdmiInput class for managing HDMI input functionalities, including port selection, video scaling, EDID info, and status queries, within the device namespace. Contains constants, class declarations, and method signatures.

classes.name: HdmiInput
classes.description: Manages HDMI Input operations such as port selection, video scaling, EDID info retrieval, and status checks.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of HdmiInput.

methods.name: getNumberOfInputs
methods.description: Returns the number of HDMI inputs available.

methods.name: isPresented
methods.description: Checks if HDMI input is currently presented.

methods.name: isActivePort
methods.description: Checks if a specific port is active.

methods.name: getActivePort
methods.description: Returns the currently active HDMI port.

methods.name: isPortConnected
methods.description: Checks if a specific port is connected.

methods.name: selectPort
methods.description: Selects a specific HDMI port with optional audio and video settings.

methods.name: scaleVideo
methods.description: Scales the video display to specified dimensions.

methods.name: selectZoomMode
methods.description: Selects the zoom mode for video display.

methods.name: pauseAudio
methods.description: Pauses audio playback.

methods.name: resumeAudio
methods.description: Resumes audio playback.

methods.name: getCurrentVideoMode
methods.description: Retrieves the current video mode as a string.

methods.name: getCurrentVideoModeObj
methods.description: Retrieves current video resolution details.

methods.name: getEDIDBytesInfo
methods.description: Retrieves EDID bytes for a specified HDMI port.

methods.name: getHDMISPDInfo
methods.description: Retrieves HDMI SPD info.

methods.name: setEdidVersion
methods.description: Sets the EDID version for a port.

methods.name: getEdidVersion
methods.description: Gets the EDID version for a port.

methods.name: getHdmiALLMStatus
methods.description: Checks the ALLM status for a port.

methods.name: getSupportedGameFeatures
methods.description: Retrieves supported game features.

methods.name: getAVLatency
methods.description: Retrieves audio and video latency.

methods.name: setEdid2AllmSupport
methods.description: Sets support for Allm in EDID.

methods.name: getEdid2AllmSupport
methods.description: Gets support status for Allm in EDID.
